name: bk_exp26_layer_rows
title: Every row is flat across layers; only the call argument loses carrying after layer 24
caption: Per-row version of s8_layer_sweep: the eight exp 22 rows, 160 items each (80/80). AUROC bands are Hanley-McNeil analytic 95% intervals (no per-item scores saved, so no bootstrap); naming bands Wilson 95% over 160 readouts. Dashed lines at chance and 0.80; grey vertical line at 42. Code language naming uses a language-name regex and is the positive control; the Markdown rows are barely readable by the probe, so there is little to carry.
